qualifying_findings.source_title: Agent Plugins 1.0 in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: GitHub announced general availability of Agent Plugins 1.0 support across VS Code, Copilot CLI, the GitHub Copilot SDK, and the GitHub Copilot app. The changelog says a plugin can package skills and MCP server configuration once, keep Copilot-specific behavior under a namespaced directory, and use managed settings plus MCP allowlists for enterprise governance.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: Portable skill-and-tool packaging is becoming a governed distribution layer for agent instructions, runbooks, and MCP access. Local practice should track how teams review plugin manifests, manage marketplaces, separate client-specific files, and pair plugin availability with MCP server allowlists.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs in retrieval/tool governance, durable instruction packaging, and adoption operating model pages rather than local product or protocol encyclopedia leaves.
follow_up_notes: During ingest, compare against remote MCP skill discovery and governance pages.
Route broad standard and product coverage to the upstream AI wiki.

qualifying_findings.source_title: AI Is Outpacing Code Review. Here's How to Catch Up (Without Slowing Down)
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: PagerDuty argued that AI-generated code can pass local review while failing in production context, especially in microservice and cloud-native systems where no single reviewer or coding agent understands the full system state.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The article reinforces system-context review as a practice requirement: AI-assisted review should include downstream dependency awareness, operational blast radius, service ownership, and incident-facing verification rather than only syntax or local diff checks.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs under intelligent code review, layered AI code review roles, verification gates, and application harness patterns.
follow_up_notes: Compare with existing pages about layered review and verification tax.
Avoid restating vendor statistics without source-qualified context during ingest.

qualifying_findings.source_title: You chose the best model. Why is your agent still failing?
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Arize and Atlan described model, context, and harness as separate layers of enterprise AI systems. They argue that agents now retrieve data, call tools, execute code, manage permissions, use memory, delegate to subagents, and work across long trajectories, so evaluation must cover context and harness behavior, not just model benchmarks.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: This maps directly to local context architecture and harness design: code agents should be evaluated against trusted sources, permissions, tools, memory, handoffs, and production workflows because public model benchmarks do not test those local layers.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs with context router and knowledge layers, agent harness components, user-visible progress and runtime telemetry, and trajectory-level agent evaluation.
follow_up_notes: During ingest, preserve the model/context/harness separation as a practice lens, not as a broad AI-system taxonomy leaf.
Check whether trajectory-level eval pages already cover tool calls and handoffs.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Anthropic's 80% Prompt Cut Shows AI Creating Its Own Technical Debt
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Futurum analyzed Anthropic's earlier context-engineering post, emphasizing a large Claude Code prompt reduction, movement from rigid rules to judgment-based guidance, progressive disclosure through skills, auto-memory, and a Claude doctor command for auditing user instruction files.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The practice implication is instruction-file maintenance debt: durable agent rules should be periodically audited, shortened, and shifted into progressive disclosure or skill files when models and harnesses no longer need old front-loaded prompts.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs with durable instructions, rules and knowledge layers, and adoption agreements around instruction hygiene.
follow_up_notes: Treat the underlying Anthropic product and model details as upstream-owned.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Code is abundant. Judgment is scarce. We raised $143 million to help it scale.
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: CodeRabbit announced Agentic Change Management alongside a Series C financing round, arguing that AI code review covers only part of the workflow. The post frames coding-agent adoption as shifting scarce engineering judgment from ticket planning toward pull-request triage, risk explanation, validation, and post-merge codebase health.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The local practice signal is that review queues are becoming change-management queues. Teams need explicit attention allocation, PR intent/risk summaries, validation gates, and post-merge health checks for agent-generated changes.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs with intelligent code review, delegated coding handoffs, lifecycle AI review gates, and adoption operating agreements.
follow_up_notes: Route funding, customer, and product-category background upstream.
Keep local ingest focused on judgment allocation and review workflow changes.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Show your sources: building verifiable, citable AI agents with MCP
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: Digital Science described MCP-backed access to structured research data as a way to ground AI agents in current, verified, citable sources while keeping the user's prompts and internal processing private from the data provider.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: For codebase and documentation RAG, the article reinforces a source-ingest principle: agents should preserve source citations, separate trusted data retrieval from model reasoning, and document privacy and data-flow boundaries around MCP integrations.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs with source reconciliation, clipping/raw intake, RAG provenance, and MCP scoped authorization pages.
follow_up_notes: During ingest, avoid creating local MCP server leaves for Dimensions or Altmetric.
Extract only the citation and privacy-boundary practice.

qualifying_findings.source_title: Your OpenAPI Spec Is Not an Agent Interface: Compiling Governed MCP Tool Surfaces
qualifying_findings.date_qualification: In-window because August 12 is strictly after the 2026-08-11T00:32:13Z cutoff.
qualifying_findings.short_factual_summary: The post argues that an OpenAPI specification is not automatically an agent-safe interface and presents an API-to-MCP compiler concept for constrained tool surfaces, governance, and code generation.
qualifying_findings.why_it_matters_for_ai_assisted_developme: The local practice implication is that tool-call surfaces should be compiled, scoped, and reviewed for agent behavior instead of exposing raw API breadth. Tool schemas, permissions, and generated adapters need design and verification gates.
qualifying_findings.local_practice_implication: Candidate synthesis belongs with tool-call and MCP governance, MCP scoped authorization, and agent harness component design.
follow_up_notes: Verify the linked repository and docs only during an ingest pass if a durable local practice note is created.
Route package and tool background upstream.
